escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a vast dark archive-like hall at night, slight low camera angle): she stands at about 64% of the frame width, framed from the waist up, beside an immense wall of THOUSANDS of thin dark glass cards in LANDSCAPE orientation, each about twice as wide as it is tall, like anonymous search-result cards, with square-ish corners — never vertical, never shaped like phones or tablets, stacked in endless rows that recede into the darkness on the right. With one arm extended she is PULLING one card out of the wall, as if drawing a book from a shelf: the moment her fingers touch it, it becomes ONE wide horizontal glass card in landscape orientation that BLAZES: brilliant white glass face with an intense azure-blue (#0375DB) core glow, a thin teal (#36C8BF) rim, on its face only a soft round placeholder circle on the left and three soft horizontal bars of light, no letters, no logos, no phone shape, radiating light rays and a cloud of fine particles that flood her face and jacket with cool white-blue light, while every other card in the wall stays dark. She looks straight into the lens with a quiet, confident half-smile. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens. She wears the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, no lanyard, no watch, no rings. Her head stays almost frontal, both eyes and both eyebrows visible, and stays in the middle band of the frame height, never touching the top edge. The LEFT HALF of the frame (from 0% to 50% of the width) is calm, deep dark space with only faint haze: no cards, no screens, no beams, no light and no objects there; nothing crosses the vertical center line. Hard cool rim light from behind; haze catches the light. Enormous contrast, punchy, cinematic, no logos of any other brand, no readable text, no letters or numbers anywhere.
